title: Acquire an effective-rank channel without measuring away coherence
statement: A finite rational random threshold and actual mean-state copy simulation coherently flag one spectral pass subspace. QPE phase work is uncomputed; measuring a full eigenvalue would change the channel. One threshold is fixed across the entire use budget. Ideal filtered F has mean rank<=floor(1/a)+1; implemented Ftilde may have full ambient rank. Total source/control error pays a CPTP query hybrid to F, never a false rank promise about Ftilde.

requires: Actual fixed memoryless forward CPTP N:k->D, known logical/carrier registers and coherent known controls
Independent actual N(I/k) copies, protected quantum/reference storage and declared total finite query/error budget
A recovery competitor and intrinsic mean-tail bound only for a useful performance guarantee; not numerically required or inferred

assumptions: Ideal forward-channel query access, coherent trusted input/output controls and protected storage are substantive. Premade independent Choi states alone do not supply the full coherent preprocessing interface. One fixed threshold and one common compression frame apply to all relevant training/payload outputs; no per-record success or reusable old small-frame decoder. Huge intrinsic polynomials, ambient quantum storage and logD controls remain; no physical acquisition, device or practical advantage.
